final: WITH c AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.link_to_event AS event_id, c.cnt AS cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(c.cnt AS REAL)/t.total DESC) AS rk FROM c, t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT event_id, cnt, share FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC
